questions.prompt: Which turn barrel is the clearest give-up?

choices.text: Air, no blocker, on the card that completes the caller’s flush draw.
The nut flush when it completes

questions.explanation: No equity and a card that helped them is a check.

choices.text: Choosing a turn size that still leaves a sane river bet or a fold.
Betting your stack on every street

questions.explanation: If the turn bet commits you, be sure the hand wants to be committed.

choices.text: A small bet after the preflop raiser checked to you.

questions.explanation: Probing punishes a raiser who gave up the flop. It is not a license to blast.

questions.prompt: You barrel the turn and get raised. With one pair and no draw you usually…

choices.text: Fold. A turn raise is a strong range.

questions.explanation: The raise represents the hands that beat one pair. Continue with strong hands and strong draws, not with weak pairs.
